_note: The capsule machine's upgrade tree (the machine tab's upgrades page): you're fixing up an old, broken machine. Every NODE grows 'from' another (it shows once that one is fixed), belongs to a 'branch' (repair = the trunk, coins, chutes, balls, shiny, lights, drops), sits at 'at' [x, y] on the tree's map (0..600 x 0..460, y down), and can be bought up to 'max' levels (1 for repairs). Each level costs 'coins' x 'grow' to the power of the levels you have, plus 'bits' (machine bits pets bring home from adventures: gear, spring, bolt, glass), the same every level. 'each' is what every level does: coins_x (every capsule's coins multiplied), chutes (+1 chute: a capsule each), double / triple (chance per chute of 2 / 3 balls), shiny (chance a ball is shiny), shiny_x (a shiny ball pays this much more than x2), lights (the lucky lights and fever work), fever_s (seconds more fever), drops (new kinds of balls: toys, boxes). 'says' is the pet's line about it, 'gain' the short line of what you get, 'fixes' what it mends on the machine's picture. Numbers are placeholders until tools/machine_pace.gd tunes them.

nodes.name: tape up the crack
nodes.says: the globe has a big crack and capsules keep rolling out the side. some tape would do it!

nodes.name: oil the lever
nodes.says: the lever squeaks and sticks halfway. a drop of oil and it'll glide.

nodes.name: unstick the flap
nodes.says: the flap sticks, so half the capsules jam inside. a new spring would fix it.

nodes.name: new glass
nodes.says: the old glass is cloudy and scratched. with new glass you can see what's inside!

nodes.name: rewire the lights
nodes.says: there are little lights on the front, but the wires are all chewed. let's rewire them!
nodes.gain: x2 coins, lucky lights and fever

nodes.name: better drops
nodes.says: there's a hatch in the top, rusted shut. something else goes in there…
nodes.gain: new kinds of balls in the machine

nodes.name: shinier coins
nodes.says: polish every coin before it goes in a capsule.

nodes.name: heavier coins
nodes.says: thicker coins. they clink better, and they're worth more!

nodes.name: gold-plated coins
nodes.says: a thin layer of gold on every coin. so fancy.

nodes.name: a second chute
nodes.says: there's a second chute, all bent shut. bend it back and every pull drops two capsules.

nodes.name: a third chute
nodes.says: a third one, hiding behind a panel!

nodes.name: a fourth chute
nodes.says: we're drilling a new one. it's fine. it's totally fine.

nodes.name: double drop
nodes.says: sometimes two capsules squeeze out of one chute at once!

nodes.name: triple drop
nodes.says: three at once! the chutes are getting wider.

nodes.name: shiny balls
nodes.says: with the new glass, some capsules sparkle! a shiny one pays double.

nodes.name: brighter shiny
nodes.says: shiny balls shine even brighter now.
nodes.gain: shiny balls pay x3, then x4

nodes.name: longer fever
nodes.says: the lights stay on for longer!
